description: Scenario: callers want to express CalendarEventFilterCondition AND/OR another condition, or NOT a condition (RFC 8620 §5.5 Filter algebra). The shipped signatures are filter: Option<&CalendarEventFilterCondition> (src/methods/event.rs:154) and filter: Option<&NotificationFilterCondition> (src/methods/event_notification.rs:138) — bare conditions only, no FilterOperator wrapper. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-client uses filter: Option<serde_json::Value> (crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:143), which permits compound filters at the cost of typing. Consequence: every caller that needs a compound filter is blocked on an API break. jmap-types::Filter<T> already exists (crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs:104) so accepting Option<&Filter<CalendarEventFilterCondition>> is a typed alternative. Decide before 0.1.x ships widely: typed Filter wrapper (preferred — matches the workspace's typed-from-day-one stance) or align with the mail-client serde_json::Value shape. Picking neither and shipping is the worst option — the next caller will file an issue and we'll break the API.
title: calendar_event_query and calendar_event_notification_query filter param locks out compound AND/OR/NOT
